DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (Lipoid CAH) presenting with 46,XY DSD.

The combination of ambiguous genitalia at birth, virilization of the mother during pregnancy, and bone fragility despite being raised female is highly suggestive of a disorder of sex development, specifically Lipoid Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia where the patient is likely 46,XY.
